newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber easier in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber easier in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were easier in late trading on Monday on sustained poor demand and declines in Tokyo, traders said.
"The market is a little weaker," one trader said. "There was not much activity in the market, with demand staying thin."

He said that declines in Tokyo and Singapore futures also weighed on the already bearish sentment. Another trader said August/September SIR20 was done at 44.50 cents/lb fob Medan, but had no other details. The traders said SIR20 was offered at 44.75-45.00 cents/lb fob Medan, 44.50-44.75 cents fob Palembang, 44.375 in Surabaya, 44.25 in Padang and 44.00 in Pontianak.
